authoring.repair_policy: regenerate derived files from skill_contract.json and rerun the full gate

capabilities.trigger: Use this skill to render a Phylo-branded PDF report from structured scientific content (sections, figures, tables, metadata). Usable standalone or callable by other skills.

entries.claim: Renders a multi-page Phylo-branded PDF from a report_content.json file using ReportLab Platypus
Validates generated PDF for page count, text extractability, page size, figure embedding, and blank pages

clarification_questions.prompt: What scientific content do you want in the report?

choices.label: I have a report_content.json file ready
I will provide content elements interactively
I have analysis results from another skill

clarification_questions.prompt: Do you have specific figures or tables to include?

choices.label: Yes, I have figure file paths and table data ready
I need figures generated from my data first

clarification_questions.prompt: What metadata should appear on the cover page?

choices.label: Title, subtitle, author, date, project name

infographic.not_applicable_reason: Format utility renders provided content; does not generate qualitative infographics

execution.not_applicable_reason: Scripts are invoked directly by the agent at runtime, not as pre-validated bundled commands

external_dependencies.not_applicable_reason: No external services or APIs are called; ReportLab and pypdf are local Python packages

facts.not_applicable_reason: Pure formatter: transforms provided content into PDF, does not generate evidence-bearing claims

figures.not_applicable_reason: Format utility embeds user-provided figures; it does not generate or declare its own result figures

inference_readiness.not_applicable_reason: Pure formatter: does not perform statistical inference or population-level comparison

resource_identity.not_applicable_reason: Format utility does not emit citations, accessions, or external identifiers; it renders provided content

inputs: report_content.json: JSON file with metadata, sections (each with heading and content blocks), optional references, optional output_files_table
Figure files: PNG/SVG/JPEG images referenced by figure blocks, paths relative to the JSON file or absolute
Content blocks: paragraph (text), figure (path, caption), table (headers, rows, title), bullet_list (items), numbered_list (items), subheading (text)

workflow.title: Collect and validate content
workflow.instruction: Assemble or receive report_content.json with all sections, figures, tables, and metadata. Validate that all five required sections are present, figure paths resolve, and tables are well-formed.

workflow.title: Render the report
workflow.instruction: Run scripts/generate_report.py with the content JSON path and output PDF path as arguments, using ReportLab Platypus with Phylo branding.

workflow.title: Validate the report
workflow.instruction: Run scripts/validate_pdf.py with the output PDF path and expected figure count to check page count, text extractability, page size, figure embedding, and blank pages.

workflow.title: Copy to results root
workflow.instruction: Use staged_copy to publish the validated report as report_phylo_pdf_report_generation.pdf at the results root.

workflow.title: Write receipt
workflow.instruction: Call write_receipt with report name, outputs, and QC log to record run evidence.

caveats.statement: Figure path not found: renderer prints a placeholder paragraph instead of silently skipping
Text not extractable: validator checks pypdf text extraction length > 50 chars
Wrong page size: validator checks each page mediabox against 612 x 792 pt US Letter

existing_materials: scripts/generate_report.py: authored fresh — ReportLab Platypus renderer with Phylo branding
scripts/validate_pdf.py: authored fresh — post-generation PDF integrity checker
scripts/report_qc.py: scaffolded by phylo-create-skill — receipt and gate infrastructure
scripts/report_style.py: scaffolded by phylo-create-skill — style provider resolution

source_assertions_not_applicable_reason: No external facts are used in computation; the skill transforms user-provided content

starting_task.decision_context: A scientist needs a formal, shareable PDF deliverable from their analysis results for collaboration, stakeholder review, or regulatory submission. The PDF must be well-structured, text-extractable, and visually consistent with Phylo branding.
starting_task.objective: Transform structured scientific content into a professionally branded, multi-page PDF report with Phylo visual identity, automatic page breaks, embedded figures with captions, formatted tables, and standard report sections.
starting_task.subject_input: A report_content.json file containing metadata, 5 ordered sections (Task Context, Methods and Sources, Results, Conclusions and Interpretation, Limitations) with content blocks (paragraphs, figures with paths and captions, tables with headers and rows), references, and an output files table. Sample: RNA-seq DE analysis with 412 tested genes, 3 significant at padj < 0.05, one volcano plot figure, one top-10 DE genes table, 3 references.
starting_task.user_prompt: How do I render my scientific analysis results as a branded report?

auto.evidence: Demo run produced valid multi-page PDF with extractable text, embedded figures, US Letter page size; validate_pdf.py exited 0

guided.reason: No separate child run with user clarification selection has been performed yet
